author: António Caetano de Sousa
work: História Genealógica da Casa Real Portugueza
publisher: Officina de Joseph Antonio da Sylva
artist_or_engraver: Francisco Vieira Lusitano (invenit); Pedro de Rochefort (engraver)
notes: Portuguese institutional records identify the famous allegorical frontispiece in tomo I and distinguish it from the separate author portrait. The allegory represents the Academia Real da História: Royalty seated with sceptre, crown and cornucopia receives the work through Minerva and kneeling Poetry, while History records royal deeds beside a genealogical tree culminating in João V.
